name: Mockup Studio
shortDescription: Turn raw app screenshots into a polished store listing
fullDescription: Mockup Studio plans, designs and exports Play Store screenshots and feature graphics from your raw app screenshots. A planner agent writes the deck, a template engine renders it, a builder agent refines it, and code guardrails check every slide. Edit anything in the dashboard.
audience: Indie Android developers shipping their own apps
